AddLayout.description: Adds a layout to the specified slide master.

params.description: Position where a layout will be added.
params.name: nPos

returns.description: returns false if oLayout isn't a layout.

AddObject.description: Adds an object (image, shape or chart) to the current slide master.

params.description: The object which will be added to the current slide master.
params.name: oDrawing

returns.description: returns false if slide master doesn't exist.
return false if slide master doesn't exist.

Copy.description: Creates a copy of the specified slide master object.

returns.description: returns new ApiMaster object that represents the copy of slide master. Returns null if slide doesn't exist.

Delete.description:
Deletes the specified object from the parent if it exists.
Note: Master can't be deleted if it's the last one in the presentation.

returns.description: return false if master doesn't exist or is not in the presentation or couldn't be deleted (e.g. the last master).

Duplicate.description: Creates a duplicate of the specified slide master object, adds the new slide master to the slide masters collection.

params.description: Position where the new slide master will be added.
params.name: nPos

returns.description: returns new ApiMaster object that represents the copy of slide master. Returns null if slide master doesn't exist or is not in the presentation.

GetAllCharts.description: Returns an array with all the chart objects from the slide master.

GetAllDrawings.description: Returns an array with all the drawing objects from the slide master.

GetAllImages.description: Returns an array with all the image objects from the slide master.

GetAllLayouts.description: Returns all layouts from the slide master.

returns.description: Returns an empty array if the slide master doesn't have layouts.

GetAllOleObjects.description: Returns an array with all the OLE objects from the slide master.

GetAllShapes.description: Returns an array with all the shape objects from the slide master.

GetAllTables.description: Returns an array with all tables from the slide master.

returns.description: An array with all tables from the slide master.

GetBackground.description: Returns the background fill of the current slide master.

returns.description: returns null if the slide master doesn't exist or has no background fill.

GetClassType.description: Returns the type of the ApiMaster class.

GetDrawingsByPlaceholderType.description: Returns an array of drawings by the specified placeholder type.

GetLayout.description: Returns a layout of the specified slide master by its position.

returns.description: returns null if position is invalid.

GetLayoutByType.description: Returns the layout corresponding to the specified layout type of the slide master.

returns.description: The layout at the specified position, or null if the position is invalid.

GetLayoutsCount.description: Returns a number of layout objects.

GetTheme.description: Returns a theme of the slide master.

returns.description: returns null if theme doesn't exist.

GroupDrawings.description: Groups an array of drawings in the current slide master.

params.description: An array of drawings to group.
params.name: aDrawings

RemoveLayout.description: Removes the layouts from the current slide master.

params.description: Position from which a layout will be deleted.
params.name: nPos

returns.description: return false if position is invalid.

RemoveObject.description: Removes objects (image, shape or chart) from the current slide master.

params.description: Position from which the object will be deleted.
params.name: nPos

returns.description: returns false if master doesn't exist or position is invalid or master hasn't objects.

Search.description: Searches for the specified text within the current slide master and returns all found occurrences as text ranges.

params.description: Whether to search for whole words only.
params.name: isWholeWords

Search.signature: Search(text: string, isMatchCase?: boolean, isWholeWords?: boolean): ApiTextRange[]

SetBackground.description: Sets the background to the current slide master.

params.description: The color or pattern used to fill the presentation slide master background.
params.name: oApiFill

SetTheme.description:
Sets a theme to the slide master.
Sets a copy of the theme object.

returns.description: return false if oTheme isn't a theme or slide master doesn't exist.

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiMaster object into the JSON object.

params.description: Specifies whether to write used table styles to the JSON object (true) or not (false).
params.name: bWriteTableStyles
